paper_title: MMAR A Challenging Benchmark for Deep Reasoning in Speech, Audio,   Music, and Their Mix
caption: : Compare with noise input on MMAR
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages for three different models—Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni—when evaluated under three distinct input conditions: Audio (represented by solid blue bars), Noise (represented by solid purple bars), and Random Choice (represented by a dashed light blue line). The vertical y-axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, is scaled linearly from 0 to 60, with tick marks at intervals of 10, indicating the performance metric in percentage points. The horizontal x-axis lists the three model names in order from left to right. For each model, two bars are displayed side-by-side: the blue bar for Audio input and the purple bar for Noise input. The dashed line, representing Random Choice, is positioned at approximately 30% accuracy and serves as a reference baseline. The chart shows that for all three models, the Audio input condition (blue bars) yields higher accuracy than the Noise input condition (purple bars). Specifically, Qwen2-Audio-Instruct achieves approximately 30% accuracy for both Audio and Noise, while Audio-Reasoner achieves approximately 38% for Audio and 30% for Noise. Qwen-2.5-Omni shows the highest performance, with approximately 58% accuracy for Audio and 36% for Noise. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the model names on the x-axis.
